ambition.what: Compare revised working scenarios when actual forest conditions change.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: GIS tables and spreadsheet rules can compile exact scenario comparisons from supplied inventory and area fields without choosing forest-management actions.

assumptions: Unmeasured forest-planning episode with actual manual scenario-table compilation; shares are independent of the prompt prior.

Survey and inventory owners produce actual records; s1 counts collection and verification, s2 actual scenario authorship. No free complete plan, inferred habitat map or clean inventory feed is assumed. Missing input fields require manual resolution in s4.

s3 assembles exact comparisons only. It does not predict ecological outcomes or determine legal compliance. Existing equivalent GIS calculations and table templates are baseline and earn no new benefit; unattended runtime is not labor saving.

s4 writes the actual plan and s5 checks the complete final version. Saving records honest pending or approved status; it does not authorize harvesting, change land rights or send notifications. Any required owner or institutional approval occurs on the complete final plan before implementation.

ambition.what: Reduce exact handling around existing program and sales management.

build_days.consent_and_access: 1-3 for forest, sales and commercial-authority consultation

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: spreadsheet offer comparisons and native sales fields can reduce repeated handling of verified commercial facts without choosing a cutting program or timber sale.

assumptions: Unmeasured episode including actual cutting-program planning and a delegated timber sale; shares are independent of the prompt prior. Its activity mix is not a universal forester baseline.

Inventory owners supply actual lot records; s1 counts verification, s2 actual program planning and s3 buyer discussion and capture of actual offer fields. No free normalized offer feed is assumed. Incompatible units or uncertain quantities stop for manual resolution in s5.

s4 is the explicit exact comparison action; s5 selects the actual sale and prepares both actual final artifacts. Native fields save minor repeated entries only, not sale judgment. Existing equivalent comparisons and entry defaults earn no extra benefit.

The forester has actual delegated authority for this episode. Outside it, the real authority must review the complete final sale before commitment and its labor must be added. s6 checks both complete final artifacts; changes void the corresponding gate. Both immediate send and save are fully retained with no saving.

Physical harvesting, haulage, invoicing and payments are separate existing activities, not hidden in these commitments. If the same transaction is negotiated under task 200, count shared work once. Gross 16.4 minus 3 upkeep gives 13.4 net per 100 focal baseline hours.
